groups.instructions: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence.

questions.prompt: Students ______ live far from campus often find it hard to join evening activities.
questions.explanation: 'Who' introduces a relative clause about people when it is the subject of the clause.

questions.prompt: The government introduced a sugar tax, ______ led to a fall in soft drink sales.
questions.explanation: After a comma, a non-defining clause about a whole idea uses 'which'. 'That' cannot follow a comma in a relative clause.

questions.prompt: This is the town ______ my grandparents first met.
questions.explanation: 'Where' replaces 'in which' for places: the town where (= in which) they met.

questions.prompt: Workers ______ jobs are at risk from automation may need retraining.
______ the city has excellent public transport, many residents still drive to work.
questions.explanation: 'Although' is followed by a full clause (subject + verb). 'Despite' needs a noun or -ing form, and 'However' joins two sentences, not clauses.

questions.prompt: The researcher to ______ I sent my questionnaire never replied.
questions.explanation: After a preposition, use 'whom' for people and 'which' for things. 'Who' and 'that' cannot follow a preposition.

options.text: My sister who lives in Dubai, is a nurse.
My sister, who lives in Dubai, is a nurse.
My sister, that lives in Dubai, is a nurse.
My sister, who lives in Dubai is a nurse.

questions.explanation: A non-defining clause (extra information) needs a comma at both ends and cannot use 'that'.

questions.prompt: ______ more people work from home, demand for office space has fallen.
questions.explanation: 'As' can mean 'because' and introduces a clause. 'Due to' needs a noun phrase.

questions.prompt: The data, most of ______ was collected in 2023, shows a clear upward trend.
questions.explanation: Quantifier + of + which/whom: most of which, some of whom.

groups.instructions: Complete each sentence with ONE WORD ONLY.

questions.prompt: Not only did prices rise, {{10}} wages also fell.
The year {{11}} the factory closed was a difficult one for the town.
questions.explanation: 'When' (or 'that') introduces a relative clause after a time noun.

questions.prompt: {{12}} having a degree, she struggled to find a job in her field.
questions.explanation: 'Despite' is followed by a noun or -ing form: despite having.

questions.prompt: The reason {{13}} many students fail is poor time management.
